## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition

Berryboyzz operates India's foremost high-anthocyanin superfruit cultivation clusters, combining tissue-culture genetics with climate-controlled precision agriculture in Maharashtra. By converting conventional open-field farmland into climate-resilient polyhouses and hydroponic grow-bays, Berryboyzz achieves:
- 3.2 kg/m² annual average superfruit yields (250% higher than traditional soil cultivation).
- 85% water reduction via closed-loop automated drip irrigation.
- Guaranteed off-take pricing and 0°C–2°C cold-chain logistics to tier-1 metro retail hubs (Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR).
- High-certainty financial models delivering 16–18 month break-even horizons and 32%–48% projected internal rate of return (IRR).

---

## 2. Cultivar Agronomic Specifications

All Berryboyzz planting material is derived from elite, virus-indexed tissue-culture mother stock hardened in multi-span shade structures.

### 2.1 Sweet Charlie Strawberry
- Species: Fragaria × ananassa
- Photoperiodism: Day-Neutral / Short-Day facultative
- Chill Hours Required: 180–220 hours (<7°C)
- Optimum Canopy Temperature: 18°C–24°C daytime, 10°C–14°C nighttime
- Yield Metrics: 850–1,100 g per plant over a 160-day productive cycle
- Fruit Quality: Medium-large fruit (22–26 g), conical, 9.2° Brix sweetness, bright crimson flesh
- Best Suited For: Maharashtra plateau, Karnataka, and polyhouses in central India
- Planting Window: September to November; harvest spans December through April

### 2.2 San Andreas Strawberry
- Species: Fragaria × ananassa
- Photoperiodism: Obligate Day-Neutral
- Chill Hours Required: 250 hours
- Optimum Canopy Temperature: 16°C–22°C daytime, 8°C–12°C nighttime
- Yield Metrics: 950–1,250 g per plant
- Fruit Quality: Uniform large berries (28–32 g), exceptional firmness, 8.8° Brix, 7-day cold storage shelf life
- Best Suited For: High-density substrate troughs and export grade punnet packaging

### 2.3 Maravilla Raspberry
- Species: Rubus idaeus
- Fruiting Type: Primocane & Floricane (Double Cropping)
- Chill Hours Required: 250–350 hours
- Yield Metrics: 1.6 kg/m² per cycle (3.2 kg/m² per year under bi-annual pruning)
- Fruit Quality: Extra-large drupelet clusters (5.5–7.0 g), non-crumbly, 11.4° Brix, rich ruby pigmentation
- Pruning Regimen: Post-harvest tip pruning in May for autumn primocane flush, winter cane management for spring floricane crop

### 2.4 Prime-Ark 45 Blackberry
- Species: Rubus subg. Rubus
- Fruiting Type: Thornless Primocane
- Chill Hours Required: 300 hours
- Yield Metrics: 2.8 kg/m² annually
- Fruit Quality: Cylindrical jet-black berries (7.0–9.5 g), 10.8° Brix, strong drupelet coherence for transit resilience

### 2.5 Biloxi Southern Highbush Blueberry
- Species: Vaccinium corymbosum × V. darrowii
- Photoperiodism: Low/Zero-chill Southern Highbush
- Chill Hours Required: 150 hours (foliar hydrogen cyanamide assisted dormancy breaking if required)
- Substrate pH: Strictly maintained between 4.5 and 5.2
- Yield Metrics: 2.4 kg per mature bush (Year 3 onwards)
- Fruit Quality: Medium-large blue berries with thick waxy bloom, 12.6° Brix, crisp texture

## 3. Commercial Infrastructure & Capex Models

### Model A: Naturally Ventilated Polyhouse (NPVH)
- Structure: Class-2 G.I. tubular framework (50mm round / 40x40mm square pipes, 2mm wall thickness)
- Cladding: 200-micron UV-stabilized, diffused, anti-condensate, anti-dust polyethylene film (Ginegar / Plasto)
- Ventilation: Top continuous ridge vent (1.0m) + 3.0m side curtains with 40-mesh anti-insect screens
- Irrigation: Pressure-compensating button drippers (2.0 L/h) per plant bag
- Capex per Acre: ₹18,00,000 to ₹24,00,000 (inclusive of structural fabrication and primary fertigation head)
- Plant Density: 22,000 to 26,000 plants per acre
- Annual Revenue: ₹28,00,000 to ₹38,00,000
- Break-Even Horizon: 16 to 18 months

### Model B: Medium-Width Polytunnel System
- Structure: High-tensile galvanized steel arches (32mm diameter), 3.5m apex height
- Cladding: 150-micron UV-resistant film with seasonal retractability
- Best For: Soil-based berry farming, rapid deployment, lower initial capital barriers
- Capex per Acre: ₹12,00,000 to ₹16,00,000
- Plant Density: 18,000 to 22,000 plants per acre
- Annual Revenue: ₹18,00,000 to ₹26,00,000
- Break-Even Horizon: 14 to 16 months

### Model C: Grow-Bay Hydroponic Substrate System
- Structure: Elevated steel gutters (1.0m working height) supporting polypropylene grow bags
- Substrate: 70% coarse cocopeat + 30% perlite (0.5–1.0 mm), pre-buffered with calcium nitrate
- Automation: Priva / Netafim automated multi-channel dosing unit managing EC, pH, and proportional fertilizer injection
- Runoff Management: 20% target drainage fraction collected, filtered, UV-sterilized, and recirculated
- Capex per Acre: ₹28,00,000 to ₹36,00,000
- Plant Density: 30,000 to 34,000 plants per acre
- Annual Revenue: ₹42,00,000 to ₹58,00,000
- Break-Even Horizon: 18 to 20 months

## 4. The Biological OS: Fertigation & Crop Protocols

1. **Vegetative Flush**:
   - Electrical Conductivity (EC): 1.2–1.4 mS/cm
   - pH: 5.8–6.2 (Strawberries/Raspberries), 4.5–5.0 (Blueberries)
   - N-P-K Ratio: 3:1:2 (Nitrate-N 140 ppm, Ammoniacal-N <10 ppm, P 45 ppm, K 180 ppm, Ca 120 ppm, Mg 45 ppm)
2. **Floral Differentiation & Anthesis**:
   - Electrical Conductivity (EC): 1.5–1.8 mS/cm
   - N-P-K Ratio: 1:2:3 (Boosted Potassium and Phosphorus with chelated Boron and Zinc)
3. **Fruit Bulking & Ripening**:
   - Electrical Conductivity (EC): 1.8–2.2 mS/cm
   - N-P-K Ratio: 1:1:4 (Potassium Nitrate + Potassium Sulfate boosting anthocyanin synthesis and Brix accumulation)
4. **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**:
   - Zero chemical synthetic insecticides during harvest windows.
   - Neoseiulus californicus & Phytoseiulus persimilis predatory mites for two-spotted spider mite control.
   - Beauveria bassiana and Bacillus thuringiensis for lepidopteran pest suppression.
